description:
A new data retention policy requires purging old financial records while preserving those under legal hold. 

Goal: Delete all Invoices (and their associated InvoiceLines) from the Chinook database that are dated before January 1, 2011. 

EXCEPTION: You must PRESERVE any invoice (regardless of date) that contains at least one track from the 'Classical' genre. These are under a legal hold.

Summary of Requirements:
1. Identify invoices older than 2011-01-01.
2. Exclude invoices containing 'Classical' tracks.
3. Delete the remaining target invoices and their invoice lines.
4. Save the database to persist changes.

The database is located at: /home/ga/chinook.odb
